summary: Required claim-specific visual validation is missing. Existing commit-bound panels provide useful segmentation and tracking context, but they do not display perpendicular width chords, endpoint trimming, accepted/rejected samples, measured values, or representative-plane width selection. The repository's own validation script identifies these visual checks as remaining work, so the high-risk width claim cannot pass visual-evidence review.

evidence: Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png shows raw image, foreground probability, core probability, filled mask, instance boundaries, centerlines, and final overlay at identical framing.
Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/WT-01_z005_stages.png confirms the same seven-stage, identical-framing presentation.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json binds these artifacts and states generation at commit 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb; command `git merge-base --is-ancestor 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb 1ac87a958cb6ff3b83588617e48e40b1e8035c19` returned exit 0.

Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z005_stages.png shows thin instance-boundary and centerline marks that leave the corresponding raw-image panel unobscured.
The panels label each processing stage and explicitly state that all panels use the same ROI crop and identical pixel framing.

No inspected stage panel displays perpendicular boundary-to-boundary chords, central-body endpoint trimming, individual accepted or rejected chord samples, or a numeric width tied to an object: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z005_stages.png.

Command `rg --files | rg 'body.width|width.*(png|pdf|json)|visual.*width'` found no claim-specific width image artifact; it returned tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py, scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py, and audit metadata only.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:274-284 generates only a histogram and two summary scatterplots; these do not show the measured chord geometry on masks or raw images.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:262-267 explicitly lists review of narrow, wide, curved, short, fused-looking examples and representative-plane confirmation as remaining validation.

The general stage panels permit qualitative inspection of detections, but no claim-bound annotation identifies missed nuclei, merged neighbors, false splits, or boundary leakage and reconciles them against width outcomes.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json reports aggregate detection and clear-multi-object-merge counts but contains no object-level adjudication or width-specific visual references.
Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png shows rows labelled faint, bright, short, long, wide, curved, touching, and irregular.

Those rows visualize masks, boundaries, centerlines, and tracking context but not width chords or measured-width values, so they do not establish that MEAS-BODY-WIDTH-001 behaves correctly across the required cases.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:265 states that narrow, wide, curved, short, and fused-looking WT and mutant examples still require review.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png uses a consistent target color within each morphology row, but panel captions identify changing per-plane instance numbers rather than a persistent track identifier.
No claim-specific artifact connects a stable track identity to the largest-area technically valid plane and its selected body-width value.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:266 explicitly lists representative-plane selection on linked observations of the same nucleus as remaining validation.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:274-284 defines the available width figure as a distribution histogram plus area/length and ellipse-minor-axis scatterplots.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:248-252 correctly states that mask-derived agreement is not proof of absolute biological accuracy, but no complementary chord-overlay evidence is present.

findings.title: No object-level visual evidence of the claimed chord measurement
findings.impact: The reviewer cannot verify that chords are perpendicular, intersect the intended filled-mask boundaries, exclude tapered endpoints, avoid neighboring instances, or remain readable without obscuring the measured geometry. Because visual-evidence review is required for this high-risk claim, acceptance is blocked.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png shows masks, boundaries, and centerlines but no chord samples.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/WT-01_z005_stages.png shows masks, boundaries, and centerlines but no chord samples.
Command `rg --files | rg 'body.width|width.*(png|pdf|json)|visual.*width'` found no claim-specific width image artifact.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:274-284 produces summary charts rather than object-level chord overlays.
findings.recommendation: Generate commit-bound, identical-framing raw/probability/mask/boundary/centerline/chord/final-overlay panels. Mark endpoint-trim regions, accepted and rejected chords, median chord, measured width, and scale for representative WT and mutant objects.

findings.title: Required adversarial visual coverage is acknowledged as unfinished
findings.impact: The evidence does not demonstrate width behavior for narrow, wide, curved, short, touching or fused-looking objects, nor show how segmentation leakage, merges, or splits affect the reported width.
evidence: scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:260-267 labels these reviews as remaining validation.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png supplies morphology-labelled tracking examples but omits width chords and values.
findings.recommendation: Provide width-specific examples covering faint, bright, curved, short, long, narrow, wide, touching, fused-looking, and irregular objects in both groups, including documented failure cases and unavailable-width outcomes.

findings.title: Representative-plane width selection lacks visual traceability
findings.impact: The claim that the largest-area technically valid observed plane supplies track width cannot be visually verified, and an incorrect plane or identity change could silently alter the primary measurement.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png shows changing instance identifiers across planes without persistent track IDs, plane areas, validity states, chord widths, or a selected-plane marker.
scripts/validate_v571_body_width.py:266 identifies representative-plane confirmation as remaining validation.
findings.recommendation: Add a linked-plane panel with persistent track ID, observed-plane instance IDs, filled-mask areas, technical-validity status, chord widths, and an explicit marker identifying the selected representative plane.

limitations: Raw microscopy sources referenced by audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json are external paths and were not independently reopened.
No full image stack or expensive inference was run, as instructed.
The tracking review directly inspected the KJ-01 stratified panel; this was sufficient to establish the missing width-specific annotations but not to adjudicate every track.
Artifact hashes could not be recomputed because PowerShell Get-FileHash was blocked by the constrained execution environment; manifest bindings were inspected instead.
recommended_follow_up: Create a dedicated MEAS-BODY-WIDTH-001 visual-evidence manifest bound to reviewed commit 1ac87a958cb6ff3b83588617e48e40b1e8035c19.
Include identical-framing raw, probability, filled-mask, boundary, centerline, chord-sample, and final-overlay panels with unobscured geometry and readable legends.
Include object-level examples for all required intensity, morphology, and contact categories in WT and mutant specimens.
Add persistent track IDs and plane-by-plane area, validity, width, and selected-representative-plane annotations.
Run a new append-only audit after the missing visual evidence is committed.
